property_summary: Only the current owner can successfully call transferOwnership; if a transferOwnership call from this test contract reverts then c.owner() remains unchanged, otherwise it becomes the newOwner argument.
compiler_error: a state-changing call on c is not a plain top-level statement, or c is reached through a low-level call / abi.encodeWithSignature / address cast / interface / helper. Every call must be `c.f(args);`, `x = c.f(args);`, or `try c.f(args) { ... } catch { ... }` at top level of the single public function; only view calls may sit inside require/assert

property_summary: Either transferOwnership succeeds and sets owner to newOwner, or it reverts and owner remains unchanged from immediately before the call.
Calling owned() must only succeed when msg.sender equals c.owner(), otherwise it reverts; when it succeeds it does not change the owner.
transferOwnership, when it returns (does not revert), sets c.owner() equal to the newOwner argument; if it reverts, owner remains equal to its value immediately before the call.
